text.p: The following are reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Opposition politicians question figures for state budget this year, citing falling inflation and large informal sector or "black" economy.
- Estonian Oil Service has donated 2.4 million kroons for restoration of "Estonia" Theatre. Total cost is estimated at 113.8 million kroons.
- Crime rate is dropping in Estonia but criminals are becoming more professional, crime prevention council said.
- Police in north-eastern city of Narva fear a serial killer may be stalking women in the city. Four women have been murdered in Narva in the past month.
- Businessmen Robert Lepikson and Priit Vilba have declared themselves candidates for mayoral race in Tallinn.
- US energy firm Coastal Corp seeks further investment opportunities in Estonia after opening an oil terminal and pipeline here.
